notes.title: UI Update
notes.notes:
This update contains some big UI changes, to buttons, backgrounds, and the color lab. These make the game more enjoyable to play for a longer time.


Added 'all-on' and 'all-off' buttons to the color lab, so you can easily clear and add colors to what your trying to mix.
Color Lab is also bigger to fill more space and make it easier to mix colors
Changed color of background to a lightish blue instead of a gray
Dynamic background is now optional inside the settings menu
Changed color of level buttons to match menu screen buttons
